en.oneLiner: Job pay is arranged directly between you — Slashie never handles it. Meet safely.
en.heading: Paying & meeting safely
en.body: Agree the price and settle up yourselves. Slashie does not process job payments, and does not verify or supervise offline meetings. Only meet when you feel safe.
en.acceptHint: You will book this worker on Slashie. Payment stays between you. Read the safety notes before inviting someone to your home.
en.completeOneLiner: Confirm you were paid directly, then close the job. Meet safely.

zh_hk.oneLiner: 工作酬勞由你們直接安排 — Slashie 從不經手。見面時請注意安全。
zh_hk.heading: 付款與安全見面
zh_hk.body: 雙方自行議價並付款。Slashie 不處理工作款項，也不核實或監督線下見面。只在你感到安全時見面。
zh_hk.acceptHint: 你會在 Slashie 預訂此工作者。付款仍由你們自行安排。邀請對方到府前，請先閱讀安全提示。
zh_hk.completeOneLiner: 確認對方已直接付款後，再結束工作。見面時請注意安全。
